title: MemoryManagerOutput
description: Output for the memory_manager tool. Returns the operation result and schema version for forward-compatibility.

result.description: The return value of the memory operation. Shape depends on op: load_for_generation returns a PromptPairHistoryContext object; append_long_memory and write_pair return null on success; prune_long_memory returns the number of entries removed.

schema_version.description: Version string of the memory schema used (e.g., '1.0'). Allows callers to detect schema migrations.

error.description: Error message if the operation failed, otherwise null.
